document_type: BSVoice-CAD SPEC suite and corpus manifest (v1.5.x)

findings.title: Contradiction in DHF closure reason storage between observability-grade logs and schema references
findings.location: SPEC-00 Changelog v1.5.0 §6 Glossary ('Closure REASON ... is recorded in orchestrator structured logs (Serilog `session_closed` event) ... NOT in the DHF schema') vs SPEC-04 §6.2 and SPEC-02 §9.0.4
findings.evidence: SPEC-00: "Closure attribution is observability-grade; DHF audit integrity does not depend on closure reason." SPEC-04 §6.2 still references explicit_shutdown paths that could leak into DHF; SPEC-02 §9.0.4 ties TeardownReason to DHF closure.
findings.problem: The claim that closure reason lives only in Serilog is violated by cross-references that treat it as part of the audit trail.
findings.why_it_matters: Breaks the core audit-integrity promise; downstream compliance claims in SDR-TL-006 become false under adversarial audit.
findings.proposed_fix: Remove all closure_reason columns/references from DHF schema, triggers, and recovery events. Make Serilog the single source of truth and update every cross-reference.

findings.title: Brittle dependency on perfect LLM JSON output in bouncer and synthesis despite deterministic pipeline claim
findings.location: SPEC-07 §4.2 Bouncer system prompt ('strict JSON, no prose, no code fences'), §6.2 Synthesis system prompt (identical strict-JSON requirement), and §11.1 ('recorded/mocked responses' for all tests)
findings.evidence: Bouncer and synthesis prompts both demand exact JSON with closed enums; all tests use mocks; no runtime schema validation or fallback parser is specified.
findings.problem: LLMs are stochastic; prompt drift or model update can produce malformed output, breaking the entire pipeline. The 'deterministic after bouncer' framing is false.
findings.why_it_matters: Creates adversarial scenarios (slight prompt change, model swap) that are not caught by build tests and violate the BSMS 'ground-truth database' guarantee.
findings.proposed_fix: Add runtime JSON schema validation with fallback to deterministic parser or human-in-loop. Make live-model semantic-equivalence tests mandatory in CI (not just canary).

findings.title: Unscoped licensing, ETL cost, and maintenance burden for 19k-row materials catalog
findings.location: CAD_VOCAB_CORPUS.md §2.5 Materials Catalogs ('19,295' rows, 'ASTM Compass (licensed) or ASTM Index', 'licensed data access (ASTM Compass, SAE)') and §6 ETL Plan ('Phase 3 ... ~30,000 rows ... 4 developer-weeks + licensed data access')
findings.evidence: Tier-2 materials catalog is required for v1.0 Medtronic but no licensing review, budget, or timeline appears in SPEC-00 §3 Mandatory vs Stretch or SPEC-07 §10.
findings.problem: The corpus manifest assumes free access to data that is not free; demo slice is only 22 rows while 'full' catalog is production requirement.
findings.why_it_matters: Scope drift and complexity inflation; legal/compliance risk for regulated customer rollout; contradicts 'BSMS at every phase' claim.
findings.proposed_fix: Move full materials catalog to stretch scope or identify open-source alternative. Add explicit licensing review gate to SPEC-00 §5 Review Order before any Phase-2 work.

findings.title: Overengineered immutability triggers with repeated bugs and maintenance burden across versions
findings.location: SPEC-04 §3.1 migrations 005/006/008/009 and changelog entries (v1.5.1 M2 'guard_session_update trigger gap closed', v1.5.2 C2 'excluded-columns table no longer contradicts')
findings.evidence: Multiple trigger rewrites for locked_at/lock_reason/ended_at transitions; v1.5.1 M2 closed a gap where lock_reason could be set without locked_at.
findings.problem: Complexity in DB triggers could be replaced by application-level enforcement plus architecture tests; creates operational risk (DBA must maintain triggers forever).
findings.why_it_matters: Brittle; any missed edge case breaks the audit-integrity promise that underpins SDR-TL-006 regulatory framing.
findings.proposed_fix: Simplify to application-level enforcement with NetArchTest rules. Retain triggers only for core append-only protection on entries/tool_calls. Update SDR-04-002 and remove most guard_session_update logic.
